procedureDepartures: HOW 10.10 (E-F cold window adoption, E-G exact profiles, section 11 RecoveryRequired transition) was amended in the same session after the first owner edits had begun, not strictly before all dependent implementation.

Auxiliary pre-stage checks ran in a copy at /private/tmp/abg-sw3/check (declared test temp root), with node_modules symlinked read-only to the rc2-dogfood-01 toolchain; it was removed after the stage. A profile-reconstruction script and a falsifier backup (actor_process.js.orig, check-copy JS only) were also kept there and removed afterwards.

The actor-successor falsifier (adoption of decision.successorPrefix removed) ran against compiled JS in the check copy, not the worksite. It failed as required, and the original was restored before the copy was deleted.
tsc --noEmit ran against the worksite tsconfig (no emit, no build info).
The RC6 historical case imports the installed RC6 packaged event_store.js read-only, in process, to write a temporary RC6 store. Installed files were not modified or copied.

No packaged S2 writer is selected. The S2 historical case writes S2 rows through a declared test stand-in for the row-identity formula (exact 3bcc stamp, canonical payload digest, eventId over the stamped envelope), then decodes them with the current cold decoder.

The retained-historical case's old assertion counting stdout probes (retained+1) was never reached at S2 because of its first digest assertion. It omitted the startup coverage probe and now asserts the exact coverage/activity sequence.
residuals: Only W can be written by the native liveness writers (frame clock, frame/CCall liveness, probe append, threshold). RC6/S2 stores are cold-readable and fold under their own tables, but they take no native continuation. This is intended (no old-P native continuation); Root should confirm.
Initial-origin recovery still requires the W profile.

Cold window validation runs in readRuntimeEventsAtDurablePrefix and decodeRuntimeHistoryDescriptor (reopen, recover, both direct readers). validateHistoricalEvents (the bare byte decoder shared with event_log.persistEventLog) does no archive reads.

Unchanged in-scope paths: runtime_liveness_contracts.ts, event_prefix.ts, public/binding/owner_contract_source_set.ts, gtl/worksite_command_execution.ts, t287-native-workspace-work.test.mjs, r10-private-owner-harness.mjs.
